code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low oxygen saturation/PaO2), with mild leukopenia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated ferritin, LDH, and alkaline phosphatase, suggesting significant inflammation or possible infection. Elevated INR indicates coagulopathy. The findings are concerning for acute respiratory failure with possible underlying infection or systemic inflammatory response; urgent clinical assessment and intervention are recommended.
